title: Disappointing.
text:
A generous family member got a subscription to Young Chefs’ Club for my son for Christmas. Our first box arrived today and we were so excited to open it up. We have had a Kiwi Box subscription for several months now and the anticipation of opening the box and starting a new project together is great fun.
Sadly, the Young Chefs’ club box is just a pile of folded papers and one small kitchen tool (in this case, a gummy candy mold)). Because there aren’t any foods included in the box, there is very little immediate gratification. Instead, they include a hefty shopping list of ingredients (approximately 32 items!) that you might have on hand but probably don’t (gelatin? Anchovies?). The cost of the shopping list could easily be $50 which, added to the cost of the box itself, would be entirely too much to spend on some kitchen experiments in my opinion. That’s more than entire meal subscriptions that include recipes AND FOOD FOR SEVERAL PEOPLE. There’s no menu box for this pile of recipes we’ve been sent either. Just the cardboard box it was shipped in.

The actual recipes are not so bad. I just would have expected either a much lower price point or sent with actual products that could be used at the time of opening the box.
label: negative
